statement: For a normal algebraizable strict-local surface or threefold germ over Fpbar with regular puncture, the rational top Chow group of the puncture vanishes in every positive characteristic
depends_on: C.3bc; Cossart-Piltant2019 Th1.1 and Prop4.4; Stacks54.4.1; Kollar-Witaszek2026 Lemmas6/8; Cossart-Jannsen-Saito2013 Cor0.4; normal Hartogs and relative global generation
notes: The regular-puncture condition is automatic for normal surfaces and is retained for threefolds. The corrected proof principalizes a rank-one-sheaf ideal on the initial regular projective resolution, preserving the puncture at every step. Initial source-scope shortcut is explicitly superseded. Restricted low-dimensional corollary; no main-gate reset or priority claim.
